text: The saved-search properties migration formats virtual-folder-sources-chosen with a numeric count through an explicit synchronous Localization. It guards an empty URI string to produce zero and keeps the verbose folder-name tooltip separate, removing that tooltip at zero. The concrete chosenFoldersCount binding matches the label ID. The fixed formatter resource list has only virtualFolderProperties.ftl, unlike the original two-resource getter. The migration preserves the old plural patterns through PLURALS and #1-to-count replacement. The changed test waits for pending document localization, but its existing message-less checks cover English two/three counts, not zero, singular, tooltip text or all locale categories.
title: Saved-search count text and folder-name tooltip use separate localization paths
